name: Asian Steak & Mango Salad with Bell Pepper & Romaine

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g ribeye steak
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Wash, dry, and juice lime into a small bowl. Add ginger, oil, honey, and soy sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lime
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry lettuce. Chop crosswise into 1 inch strips. Transfer to a large bowl.

Wash and dry mango, bell pepper, and green onions. Peel, cut flesh away from the pit, julienne (cut into thin strips), and add mango to bowl with lettuce. Seed, julienne, and add pepper to bowl. Trim and discard root ends, chop green onions, and add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 mango
1 red bell pepper
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, arrange salad on a plate and top with steak slices. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
